title: Separated locally quasi-finite scheme morphisms satisfy effective fppf descent
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: A locally quasi-finite object need not itself be quasi-compact, so quasi-affine descent cannot be applied globally. The proof saturates each affine open under the descent isomorphism, proves the saturation quasi-compact and invariant using the cocycle, descends these quasi-affine pieces and glues their effective descent data.
